| *(optional)* `playwright-core` **1.63.0** (pinned) | sh"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ips with the plugin as an optional dependency; the capture motor drives Chromium, Chrome or Edge, an"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"d answers `NEEDS_BROWSER` with the one-line remedy when none is present |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 🔐 Security & network posture"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **No phone-home.** The plugin's ONLY outbound network calls go to the instance
URL you put in `.en"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"v`. No telemetry, no update checks, no third-party
endpoints.
- **Transport guard (fail-closed).** `"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"http://` is accepted only for loopback
hosts (`localhost`, `127.x`, `::1`, `*.localhost`); anything "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"else must be
`https://`, otherwise credential loading is refused — plain http to a remote
host would"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" ship the API key in clear text.
- **Secret containment.** The secret is read once by `credentials.t"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s` and only
injected into RPC parameters. Every tool output passes through two-layer
redaction (know"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"n secret + generic `password=` / `Bearer` / `api_key=` /
`session_id` shapes) and home-path masking "},{"id":"p12s8","text":"(`/home/user/…` → `~/…`) before
being shown to the model or persisted to the KB.
- **Session cookies"},{"id":"p12s9","text":" never reach the model.** `odoo_session` writes the cookie to
`.sdd/session.json` (chmod 600) and re"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"turns only the path. The capture motor
does not even write one: it authenticates the web session in "},{"id":"p12s11","text":"memory and keeps
the cookie there for the browser context.
- **The capture browser is locked to the "},{"id":"p12s12","text":"instance origin.** Every request that
leaves the instance's base URL is aborted, so a page that trie"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"s to reach a
third-party host fails instead of loading. Capture is read-only by default:
steps that "},{"id":"p12s14","text":"only observe (`goto`, `menu`, `wait`, `assert`, `explore`,
`screenshot`, `confirm`) always run; step"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"s that act (`new`, `fill`, `select`,
`press`, `click`) require `allow_actions=true` AND `confirm_des"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"tructive=true`,
the guard classifies that call as a mutation (spec in a writing phase or a
waiver) —"},{"id":"p12s17","text":" and **a click has no compensating entry**: unlike a CRUD call, the
plugin cannot undo what the UI d"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"id. Capture against a disposable database.
- **A recording is read as data, and credentials are refu"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"sed.** `odoo_manual
operation=import` parses the `codegen` text; a recording carrying a password
fie"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"ld, an `Authorization` header or a cookie is rejected by line, and the
value is never echoed back.

there is no ephemeral cloning (by design: you provision and own the target).
`sdd_checkpoint` reve"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"rses data written through `odoo_execute`, but a module
install/upgrade is **not** reverted at databa"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"se level. Use a disposable
database.
- **Static security scan scope** — `odoo_security_scan` is rule"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"-based over source
text (no AST, no taint tracking), so it catches the common Odoo mistakes, not
eve"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"rything; it complements a human review, never replaces it.
- **The change policy covers tool calls, "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"not the shell** — `write`/`edit` and the

because the host exposes no after-the-fact inspection of what a shell command
w"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"rote. The policy makes the pipeline the path of least resistance and the
exception visible; it is no"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"t a sandbox.

profile"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"s (`dev`, `staging`).
